title: 夜

sentences.imagePrompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: L239-S01 lesson image for a children's character-recognition app
Primary request: square image / 1:1 composition. At night, protagonist mother takes protagonist little girl to a lively night market entrance with warm lanterns, food carts, and crowds, but every stall front is completely blank with no readable signs.
Visual cast: protagonist mother with white or beige top, wide blue pants, shoulder-length dark hair; protagonist little girl with pink jacket, white shirt, blue skirt, pink shoes, small pink hair clip. Use L154/L162/L163 family continuity. L058 is style reference only, not a face or clothing reference.
Composition: mother and girl centered in foreground, night market entrance and glowing stalls behind them, clear nighttime sky, safe margins for phone square crop.
Style: warm hand-painted watercolor children's textbook illustration, lively but not crowded.
Avoid: no written text, numbers, signs, signboards, price tags, labels, logos, brands, watermarks, zhuyin, or readable marks anywhere.
sentences.imageNotes: 主角媽媽帶主角小女孩晚上去夜市，夜市入口和燈光很熱鬧，但不能有任何可讀文字或招牌。畫面要清楚呈現「晚上去夜市」。主角媽媽與主角小女孩使用既有家庭角色設定。不可有文字、數字、招牌、價格、品牌或標籤。

sentences.imagePrompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: L239-S02 lesson image for a children's character-recognition app
Primary request: square image / 1:1 composition. Inside a night market, a clearly distinct night-market vendor sells many hats at a hat stall; protagonist little girl and protagonist mother stand nearby looking at the hats.
Visual cast: protagonist mother with white or beige top, wide blue pants, shoulder-length dark hair; protagonist little girl with pink jacket, white shirt, blue skirt, pink shoes, small pink hair clip; night-market hat vendor is a separate adult role with short gray hair, green vest, and apron, visually distinct from protagonist mother and teacher. L058 is style reference only.
Composition: hat stall centered with hats clearly visible, vendor behind the stall, mother and girl at one side, nighttime lights, safe margins.
Style: warm watercolor night-market illustration, friendly expressions.
Avoid: no text, numbers, price tags, signboards, brand marks, hat labels, logos, watermarks, zhuyin, or readable marks.
sentences.imageNotes: 夜市裡有帽子攤，攤販正在賣帽子，主角小女孩和主角媽媽可在旁邊看帽子。攤販是清楚的夜市攤販角色，不能長得像主角媽媽或老師。帽子攤不能有可讀文字、數字、價格、品牌或標籤。

sentences.imagePrompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: L239-S03 lesson image for a children's character-recognition app
Primary request: square image / 1:1 composition. A ball field at night is brightly lit by tall floodlights; the open field is clearly visible, with a few children or passersby in safe areas but no uniforms with numbers.
Visual cast: any background children or passersby are generic minor roles, visually distinct from protagonist family and teacher, small and not the focus.
Composition: bright field centered, floodlights visible, dark night sky contrast, safe margins, enough field context to read as a ball field.
Style: warm watercolor children's illustration, safe nighttime community mood.
Avoid: no text, numbers, scoreboard, jersey numbers, signs, labels, logos, brands, watermarks, zhuyin, or readable marks.
sentences.imageNotes: 夜裡的球場開著明亮燈光，球場空間清楚可見，可有幾個孩子或路人在安全區域活動，但不要有比賽號碼或文字標示。畫面重點是「夜裡的球場很亮」。不可有文字、數字、招牌或標籤。

sentences.imagePrompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: L239-S04 lesson image for a children's character-recognition app
Primary request: square image / 1:1 composition. Beside a ball field at night, several small shops or stalls with different appearances line the edge of the field; nearby people enjoy the evening, and the ball field is visible in the background.
Visual cast: multiple shopkeeper or stall-vendor roles with varied clothing, ages, and faces; they must all look distinct from protagonist mother and teacher. They are shopkeeper roles, not protagonist family.
Composition: ball field edge and several shop fronts centered, at least three visually different stalls, warm lights, safe margins.
Style: warm watercolor community night scene.
Avoid: no text, numbers, signboards, price lists, labels, brand marks, logos, watermarks, zhuyin, or readable marks on any shop or object.
sentences.imageNotes: 球場邊有好幾家小店或攤位，店家外觀各不相同，附近可見球場與夜間活動人群。店家角色可以是多位不同攤販或店主，不能都長得像主角媽媽或老師。畫面要呈現「球場邊有很多店家」。不可有文字、數字、招牌、價格、品牌或標籤。

sentences.text: 這家店太貴了，不要進去。
sentences.spokenText: 這家店太貴了不要進去
sentences.imagePrompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: L239-S05 lesson image for a children's character-recognition app
Primary request: square image / 1:1 composition. Protagonist little girl and protagonist mother stand outside one store entrance; protagonist mother looks at the goods inside and at a plain wallet in her hand, gently reminding the girl not to go in because the store feels too expensive. Inside the store, plain clothes and hats are visible with no prices or labels.
Visual cast: protagonist mother with white or beige top, wide blue pants, shoulder-length dark hair; protagonist little girl with pink jacket, white shirt, blue skirt, pink shoes, small pink hair clip. Use L154/L162/L163 family continuity. L058 is style reference only.
Composition: mother and girl centered outside the entrance, store goods visible inside, mother's cautious expression clear, safe margins.
Style: warm watercolor family-life illustration, calm guidance rather than scolding.
Avoid: no text, numbers, store signs, prices, tags, labels, brands, logos, watermarks, zhuyin, readable marks, or marked money.
sentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩和主角媽媽站在一家店門口外，媽媽看著店裡商品和手上的錢，溫和地提醒這家店太貴了，不要進去。店裡可見衣服或帽子等商品，但不能有價格或標籤。畫面要清楚呈現「覺得這家店太貴，所以不要進去」。不可有文字、數字、招牌、價格、品牌或標籤。
